scorecard.rationale: The published MCT crossover now reports global Parkinson cognition rather than a separate executive outcome. The adjusted phase comparisons are inconclusive and participants selected C8/C10 supplements. Its prior registry and materials are a likely shared family with a design discrepancy. A small extra-virgin oil trial outside Parkinson disease observed slower switching than sunflower oil, and a healthy-adult whole-diet crossover did not detect an executive task difference. None provide the separately measured refined coconut oil and Parkinson executive-function comparison.
